summary: Iteration 2 backend-only regression + new-feature testing of Wolf's Mind gestionale against the public preview URL. Rewrote /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (42 pytest tests) for the refactored API: numero_tessera on tesserato, president_signature_base64/logo on organizzazione, TipoPacchetto.esclude_da_compensi, ricevuta attribution (emesso_per_id) + movimento sync, RicevutaItem.esclude_da_compensi compensi math, physical DELETE ricevuta with counter decrement/number reuse, lezioni collettive with partecipanti[], /abbonamenti/{id}/storico, /movimenti/riepilogo-mensile, dashboard admin vs tecnico scoping, PDF auth (cookie 200 / anon 401) and bilancio PDF, email with PDF attachment, RBAC. Result: 40/42 passed (95%). All requested functional flows PASS. 2 failures: brute-force lockout never triggers behind the ingress (real defect), and legacy tipi_pacchetto docs are returned without the esclude_da_compensi field.

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout does NOT work in practice. Counter key is f'{request.client.host}:{email}' and the k8s ingress presents several client IPs (observed 10.49.134.130 and 10.49.134.134 for 6 consecutive attempts -> counts 2 and 4), so the >=5 threshold is never reached. 6 wrong passwords all returned 401. Key the counter on email only (optionally + X-Forwarded-For first hop) and add a TTL index on login_attempts.

Documents created before the new flag are returned WITHOUT 'esclude_da_compensi' (e.g. '1 lezione', 'Donazione'), so the frontend receives undefined instead of false. Add a default in the response projection or run a one-off migration ($set esclude_da_compensi:false where missing).

500 Internal Server Error when organizzazione.logo_base64 / president_signature_base64 contains base64 that decodes but is a corrupt image stream (reportlab raises 'broken data stream when reading image file' during doc.build; _image_from_b64 only guards the constructor, not the lazy decode). Validate the bytes eagerly (PIL Image.open+verify) inside the try, so a bad upload degrades gracefully instead of breaking every PDF/email.

No cascade: lezioni still reference the deleted abbonamento inside partecipanti[], leaving orphan participants (previous single-abbonamento model deleted the lessons). Same for DELETE /api/tesserati (abbonamenti/ricevute/lezioni not cleaned).
Response field numero_riutilizzabile is `counter and counter.get('seq')==seq`, which yields null (not false) when the year counter document is missing. Coerce to bool.
Updates filter out None values, so a field can never be cleared (e.g. removing numero_tessera or scadenza_visita_medica is impossible via the API).

App-level CORS is now correct (echoes https://multi-tech-associate.preview.emergentagent.com with allow-credentials, verified on port 8001), but the k8s ingress rewrites Access-Control-Allow-Origin to '*' on the public URL. Not an app bug; no action unless cross-origin cookie auth is needed.

action_items: Fix login lockout keying (email-based, not request.client.host) - currently no brute-force protection at all behind the ingress
Backfill/default esclude_da_compensi on existing tipi_pacchetto documents
Harden _image_from_b64 to validate image bytes so a corrupt logo/signature cannot 500 all PDF endpoints
Consider cascade cleanup of lezioni partecipanti on abbonamento/tesserato delete
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 858 lines - split into routers (auth/users, tesserati/abbonamenti/lezioni, ricevute, contabilita/report).
Ricevuta counter is now incremented after tesserato validation (iteration-1 gap fixed) - verified no number burn on 404.
serialize() strips _id/password_hash - verified no leaks in every tested response, including /abbonamenti/{id}/storico nested docs.
Date filters compare 'YYYY-MM-DD' against ISO timestamps lexicographically (date_to + 'T23:59:59'); works but fragile - consider normalized storage.

PDF signature verified programmatically: receipt with president_signature_base64+logo embeds 4 image XObjects and is larger than the no-image version; bilancio PDF renders title and 'Periodo:' as separate flowables with a 4mm Spacer (no overlap possible).
seed_data_creation: All ephemeral and cleaned up by fixtures: tecnico users test_tec_<hex>@example.com, tesserati TEST_Rossi/TEST_Bianchi, temporary abbonamenti/lezioni/ricevute/movimenti/tipo-pacchetto. login_attempts was cleared before the run. organizzazione was left with a VALID 120x40 PNG in logo_base64 and president_signature_base64 (test data - main agent may want to clear or replace with the real logo/signature).
test_credentials: admin@wolfsmind.it / Admin2026! (works, bcrypt hash verified $2b$, httpOnly access_token+refresh_token cookies set on login)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run serially: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -q -n 0 (pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; -n 0 avoids cross-class receipt-numbering races - do NOT edit pytest.ini). Only 2 tests fail: TestAuth::test_brute_force_lockout (real defect, IP-keyed counter) and TestTipiPacchetto::test_list_not_empty_and_shape (legacy docs missing esclude_da_compensi). If PDF tests 500, check organizzazione.logo_base64/president_signature_base64 for a corrupt base64 image - reset with db.organizzazione.update_one({'_id':'config'},{'$set':{'logo_base64':None,'president_signature_base64':None}}). Clear login_attempts before re-running auth tests. Email test hits real Resend with delivered@resend.dev and returned a valid email_id. Frontend has never been tested.
rca_of_the_issue: Lockout: server.py login() builds ident = f'{request.client.host}:{email}'. Behind the Kubernetes ingress each request can arrive from a different proxy pod IP, so failed attempts are spread across multiple counter documents and none reaches the 5-attempt threshold (verified directly in the login_attempts collection). PDF 500: reportlab's RLImage decodes lazily at doc.build(), so _image_from_b64's try/except around the constructor does not catch corrupt image streams; every receipt PDF / email / bilancio PDF then fails with 500 until the stored image is fixed.
